name: Cursed Kaleidoscope
source:
A young female detective is wrongly charged of the murder of her mentor. A year after her trial, she is released under the custody of senior detective Niels McLellan, and under the watchful eye of agent Alexei Nikolayev, in order to solve the Bianco household murder. However, nothing is as it seems, as the prime suspect, Lucca Bianco, has no motives for the murder. Can she solve the case, and find truth and love in a web of crime and conspiracy?

[From [url=https://orangery.itch.io/cursed-kaleidoscope]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一名年轻的女侦探被错误指控谋杀了她的导师。审判一年后，她在高级侦探尼尔斯·麦克莱伦的监护下被释放，并在特工阿列克谢·尼古拉耶夫的监视下，以侦破比安科家庭谋杀案。然而，事实并非如此，主要嫌疑人卢卡·比安科并没有谋杀动机。她能否侦破案件，并在犯罪和阴谋的网络中找到真相和爱情？

[来自[url=https://orangery.itch.io/cursed-kaleidoscope]Itch.io[/url]]
